text:
anna: starting a relnotes thread for the upcoming docs deploy. scope: Ruby SDK snippet sync, a tiny migration doc for CLI/config flags, one known-issue callout, and a short anchor/link sweep.
joel: nice. what's the Ruby change specifically?
tanya: breaking rename in Ruby SDK v0.3: ConfigParam -> RequestField, and the runtime option cache flag changed from `cache_prefix` -> `kv_cache_prefix`. Examples that do `ConfigParam.new(text: 'hi')` will error.
kevin: i'll take Ruby snippets. files to update: docs/sdk/ruby/generation.md and docs/tutorials/ruby-quickstart.md. will open PRs #4234 (generation) and #4235 (quickstart).
marta: i'll run an anchor sweep across docs/sdk/ruby and docs/cli. found two broken anchors in docs/sdk/ruby/auth.md after the header reorg. i'll patch in a small PR.
docs-bot: PR #4234 opened by kevin — Ruby generation snippet updates.
anna: tiny migration doc suggestion: docs/releases/migrate-ruby-2026-03.md with 3 examples (Ruby, shell, and brief note linking to the main relnotes). keep it short.
tanya: migration example (Ruby):
```ruby
# old
require 'redwood'
param = Redwood::ConfigParam.new(text: 'hello')

# new
require 'redwood'
param = Redwood::RequestField.new(text: 'hello')
```
and CLI flag sample: `redwood run --cache_prefix foo` becomes `redwood run --kv_cache_prefix foo`.
kevin: will normalize comment headers to "Examples use Ruby SDK v0.3" and remove any hardcoded API keys. will use env var pattern: `ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']`.
marta: PR #4236 opened — anchor fixes and two small link patches in docs/cli/flags.md.
joel: known issue to call out: in internal load tests, combining request-level batching with quantized models sometimes produced duplicated tokens at batch boundaries (ticket #587). workaround: reduce batch size or use non-quantized variant; also set boundary_padding: true in the batching config. suggest wording: "Known issue: rare token duplication at batch boundaries when using quantized models with request batching. Workaround: lower batch_size or enable boundary_padding, or pin to a non-quantized model."
anna: ok include that under "Known issues" with the ticket link and a short config snippet.
kevin: config snippet for workaround (Ruby):
```ruby
batching = { batch_size: 8, boundary_padding: true }
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], batching: batching)
```
docs-bot: PR #4235 opened by kevin — Ruby quickstart updates.
marta: also found three pages with outdated anchor IDs after the header ID change; included fixes in PR #4236. please verify anchors in staging.
kevin: timeline — marketing needs the relnotes summary by tomorrow 9am UTC. can we merge migrate-ruby and relnotes by tonight 6pm PT? i'll aim for PR reviews by 3pm PT.
tanya: also a small docs-hygiene ask: replace any example telemetry/session ids like "rwd_demo_123456" with placeholder RWD_EXAMPLE_ID. legal asked for that.
marta: i've replaced two occurrences in examples/benchmarks.md in my patch.
anna: add a short rollback block for ops: switching model alias back to previous stable alias `stable-2026-02`. include the curl snippet.
kevin: rollback curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/aliases/switch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"alias":"stable-2026-02"}'
```
joel: also note in relnotes: "Examples use Ruby SDK v0.3; please update SDK pin if you vendor snippets."
docs-bot: PR #4234 merged by kevin. PR #4235 merged by kevin. PR #4236 merged by marta.
tanya: i've drafted docs/releases/migrate-ruby-2026-03.md and linked it from relnotes. pushed to staging. preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/releases/migrate-ruby-2026-03.
kevin: i'll run a final grep for hardcoded keys and example ids and open any last-minute PRs if found.
marta: smoke checklist for relnotes merge:
- no hardcoded keys (grep returns 0)
- anchors validated in staging
- migration doc linked from relnotes
- known-issue copy reviewed by infra

anna: thanks all — ping here when staging preview is green and marketing has the short 3-bullet summary. aiming to merge by 18:00 PT. last_message_ts=1788891000
